SELECT sdr.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, COALESCE(SUM(sdr.duration_minutes), 0) AS totalMinutes FROM study_duration_record sdr LEFT JOIN course c ON sdr.course_id = c.id WHERE sdr.student_id = #{studentId} AND sdr.study_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY sdr.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY totalMinutes DESC
